description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs (trillion floating-point operations) on the x-axis and Loss Ratio (%) on the y-axis for four variants of the SepLLM model under different configurations. The x-axis spans from 1e7 to 9e8 using a logarithmic scale, with labeled ticks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 5e8, 1e9, 2e9, 5e9, and 9e9 (though only up to 9e8 is shown), and the y-axis ranges linearly from 94% to 100% in 1% increments. Four lines are plotted: SepLLM (n=64) (purple triangles, solid line) starts near 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs and plateaus near 100% after 5e7; SepLLM (n=128) (blue crosses, solid line) begins at ~97% and rises to ~99.8% by 9e8; SepLLM (n=64, H) (green diamonds, solid line) starts at ~97.5%, peaks near 100% at 3e8, and remains near 100% through 9e8; SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red circles, solid line) begins at 94% at 1e7, rises steeply to ~98.5% by 5e7, peaks at ~99.1% around 4e8, dips slightly to ~98.5% at 5e8, then stabilizes near 98.8% through 9e8. All lines show increasing or stable loss ratio with increasing TFLOPs, with the H and H/T variants exhibiting more volatility in the mid-range.
